# Lua 5.4.9

Unmodified library sources from the official release tarball
(`https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz`, SHA-256
`2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6`), without the
standalone `lua.c` / `luac.c` programs. Used for mod scripts (see `docs/MODDING.md`).
